QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`, so `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ctx->private_state`. Ordinary code that writes `ctx->state` no longer compiles. ... Library sources | `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` ... Internal code uses real field names.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that code defining the macro sees real field names while ordinary public-header consumers see the renamed `private_` names.
